content: Current real fixture pixels and the wrist-attached finger silhouettes both disagree with native measured-pose renders. Do not attribute all pixel residual to object displacement or reuse historical real coordinates after a possible scene change.
applicability: This right-arm installation and current cycle10 RGB observations; nominal CAD/factory wrist intrinsics, no depth or force
count_unit: One rejected rigid-board calibration candidate, not one full robot-task failure
known_limits: Pixel disagreement does not determine metric displacement
Finger CAD error and camera mount error are not uniquely isolated
